summary: @servicetitan/carto-tokens preinstall downloads Bun runtime to execute obfuscated in-tree bundle
details: The package declares a preinstall hook `node setup.mjs`. setup.mjs is written with hex-mangled identifiers (`_0x488df8`, `_0x52943e`) and, on install, downloads the Bun runtime from `https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v1.3.13/...` and then `execFileSync`s that downloaded Bun binary against a sibling file `math_init.js`. math_init.js is a 727KB obfuscated bundle using a rotated-string-array packer (header `// @bun @bun-cjs`, rotator function `WV8StW`, large numeric array `n7gIxM`) whose behavior cannot be read without executing under Bun. The package presents itself as a design-tokens library (DTCG JSON to vanilla-extract/Swift/Gradle) — a purpose that does not require an alternate JavaScript runtime or an opaque bundle. The combination of an alternate-runtime download at install time, an obfuscated installer script, and an obfuscated payload that only the downloaded runtime can execute gives the publisher arbitrary code execution on every installer machine while bypassing Node-based inspection.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
